entities.summary: Jalen Evander Lecque is an American professional basketball player for ONVO Büyükçekmece of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). A consensus four-star recruit and former NC State commit, Lecque chose to forgo college basketball and immediately entered the 2019 NBA draft.
